text.birdAsk: The armourer: "The King had a clockwork songbird, the finest thing I ever saw made. They say it could sing over any silence. It's broken now. Bring me its key, its spring and the bird, and I'll make it sing again."
text.partGotKey: You take the songbird's key ({k} of 3).
text.partGotSpring: You take the songbird's spring ({k} of 3).
text.birdMended: The armourer winds the songbird, and it sings. "That song will open any door." He gives you {w}.
text.birdMendedTower: The armourer winds the songbird, and it sings. "That song will open any door." He gives you {w}. The waypoint will take you up to the Quiet Tower.
text.towerShut: The door to the Quiet Tower stays shut. It opens only to a song.
text.sang: The songbird sings. The dust blows away.
text.courtAsk: The stranger: "Royal cards, eh? Bring me one of each. Princess, Prince, Queen and King. A whole court is worth more than any hand."
text.courtGiven: The stranger takes the four cards and grins. "A whole court. Here, this is worth more than any hand."
text.captainJarGot: You take a jar marked with the King's crest: the KNIGHT-CAPTAIN'S VOICE.
text.captainSilent: The knight-captain stands at his post, silent. The Silent Order took his voice.
text.captainSpeaks: The knight-captain drinks his voice back: "Stand down!" His knights lower their swords. "The King's armoury is yours. Take this."
text.captainAgain: The knight-captain: "My knights are with you."
